## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Cookie Clicker-inspired game with a mini admin console and an owner panel unlocked by code `2257`, featuring powerful commands.

## Requirements
- Deliver the game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Check screenshots when useful; screenshots should be small JPEGs at most 1280px wide.

## Decisions
- Built a standalone browser game with automatic local saves, click-to-bake gameplay, purchasable bakery upgrades, milestones, daily rewards, boosts, and ascension.
- Mini admin commands: `help`, `daily`, `stats`, `bake`, `boost`, and `hello`.
- Owner panel uses code `2257` and provides large cookie grants, a timed production boost, helper grants, crowns, milestone unlocks, reset, and lock controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Game loaded in Playwright at `http://localhost:3000`; page snapshot showed the expected game UI and controls.

### Active
- Validate gameplay interactions and owner commands in-browser.
- Save and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Browser initially could not start because Chromium was not installed; installation completed.
- The project server is available on port `3000`, not `3002`.
- One browser console error was a missing `/favicon.ico` (404); no game runtime error was observed.

## Next Move
1. Continue browser checks at `http://localhost:3000` for clicking, shop purchases, console commands, and owner unlock using `2257`.
2. Capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.
3. Address any issues found and summarize the completed game.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game layout, bakery console, owner access modal.
- `style.css`: Responsive game styling and UI.
- `game.js`: Game logic, persistence, economy, commands, owner actions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Owner commands are local single-player cheats; saves use `localStorage` key `crumb-crown-save-v1`.
- The browser snapshot showed the game rendered with 8 shop entries, milestones, mini admin console, and owner panel entry.
